parameters.name: Edition
parameters.description:
The deployment architecture of the Serverless instance. Valid values:

- shared: shared architecture. This value applies to reserved + elastic (shared) and pay-as-you-go editions.

- dedicated: dedicated architecture. This value applies to the reserved + elastic (dedicated) edition.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The instance type. Valid values for subscription instances:
- professional: Professional Edition.
- enterprise: Enterprise Edition.
- vip: Platinum Edition.

You do not need to specify this parameter for pay-as-you-go instances.

parameters.name: MaxEipTps
parameters.description: The peak TPS for public network traffic. Unit: transactions per second.

parameters.name: MaxPrivateTps
parameters.description: The peak TPS for private network traffic. Unit: transactions per second.

parameters.name: ModifyType
parameters.description:
The type of specification change. Valid values:
- UPGRADE: upgrade.
- DOWNGRADE: downgrade.

parameters.name: ProvisionedCapacity
parameters.description: The reserved TPS capacity for reserved + elastic instances.

parameters.name: ServerlessChargeType
parameters.description:
The billing type of pay-as-you-go (Serverless) instances. Valid values:
- onDemand: pay-as-you-go.

parameters.name: SupportEip
parameters.description: Specifies whether public network access is supported.

parameters.name: SupportTracing
parameters.description: Specifies whether the message tracing feature is enabled.

parameters.name: TracingStorageTime
parameters.description: The retention period of message traces.
